_comment: Local citation reference keyed by denial category. Appeal letters may only cite entries from this file - never LLM memory - to prevent fabricated regulation citations. Production: expand with payer-specific medical policies and LCD/NCD references.

medical_necessity.summary: Coverage extends to services that are reasonable and necessary for the diagnosis or treatment of illness or injury; documented clinical indications satisfy this standard.
Medical necessity determinations must be based on the clinical documentation in the record as a whole.

medical_necessity.reference: 42 C.F.R. 400.202; Medicare Program Integrity Manual Ch. 13
medical_necessity.summary: An LCD is guidance, not an absolute bar to coverage; individual clinical circumstances documented in the record must be considered.

coding_error.summary: Code selection must reflect the documented service; supporting documentation for the billed code accompanies this appeal.

coding_error.reference: NCCI Policy Manual for Medicare Services, Ch. 1
coding_error.summary: Distinct procedural services are separately reportable when performed at separate sessions, sites, or organ systems and appropriately modified.

auth_missing.reference: Pub. L. No. 116-260, Div. BB, Title I, Sec. 116
auth_missing.summary: Continuity-of-care and transparency provisions restrict retroactive denial of authorized or emergency services.
Emergency services must be covered without prior authorization requirements.

timely_filing.summary: Plans must provide a full and fair review of denied claims, including consideration of good-cause circumstances for filing delays.

cob.summary: Payer-of-order rules govern coordination of benefits; primary payer documentation is enclosed.

other.summary: Claimants are entitled, on appeal, to a review that takes into account all comments, documents, and records submitted.
